new_value: {"description":"Security/correctness self-review of the new fixed DIO fan-out: AuthenticatedDio and AuthenticatedDioOption use frozen dataclasses only. A caller holding the sealed result can use object.__setattr__ to replace internal options, option data/span, IPv6 bytes, DIO bytes, or the receipt snapshot after LinkLayer validation. DioTimeVerifier then trusts those fields without an owning-LinkLayer issuance snapshot check and must not reparse, allowing post-authentication time-option, signer, replay, or provenance substitution. Use an owning-LinkLayer issued-object registry plus immutable structural snapshot acceptance method, or an equivalently nonforgeable sealed representation, and require validation before each fixed consumer derives evidence."}
